directorate.speaker: Orr Vask
directorate.greeting: A new hull on an old border. Tell me what you intend to build.
directorate.friendly: Your word has weight here. Keep it that way.
directorate.hostile: Our ports are closed to your cargo. You may still speak.
directorate.accepted: I will have the terms entered into the public register.
directorate.declined: That proposal asks more trust than you have earned.
directorate.gift: You have paid for repairs we would otherwise postpone. We remember that.
directorate.chart: Surveyors are harder to replace than machines. This will spare a crew.
directorate.repeat: Commissioner Vask. What do you need?
directorate.allied: Your ships are cleared through our border. What is the situation?
directorate.trading: Your cargo is cleared for trade. Is there something else?
directorate.war: Our ships are still fighting. Are you calling to end this?

consortium.speaker: Tavi Rill
consortium.greeting: I’m Tavi Rill. If you’re here to trade, let’s see what you’ve brought.
consortium.friendly: Ah, our returning partner. Shall we make both our lives easier?
consortium.hostile: The exchange is closed. The conversation need not be.
consortium.accepted: Two signatures. No small print. We can work with this.
consortium.declined: I can sell a promise to my partners only once. Give me a reason.
consortium.gift: Not a loan? Then we shall name the new dock light after your ship.
consortium.chart: A route somebody has actually flown. Much better than a hopeful line.
consortium.repeat: Welcome back. Buying or selling today?
consortium.allied: Good to see you. Need supplies, or an escort?
consortium.trading: Welcome back. Your preferred prices still stand.
consortium.war: My crews are caught in this too. Are you ready to talk peace?

commune.speaker: Nema of Reeds
commune.greeting: You arrived alone. Do the others trust you, or did they send you away?
commune.friendly: There is room at the table. We kept your place.
commune.hostile: We have closed the storehouses, not our ears.
commune.accepted: An agreement is a living thing. We will both have to feed it.
commune.declined: A promise cannot grow where trust has no roots.
commune.gift: Clean water and a repaired roof. Small kindnesses travel a long way.
commune.chart: So much life, outside our knowing. Thank you for leaving it there.
commune.repeat: Welcome back. What brings you here?
commune.allied: We are listening. Tell us what you need.
commune.trading: The storehouses are open to you. What would you like to exchange?
commune.war: We cannot keep losing people. Have you come to negotiate?
